title: Payment Failures During Payment-Processor Incidents
author: Dev Patel
body:
## Inside a published incident window
When there is a published payment-processor incident, a card payment that failed inside the incident window is caused by the incident. Explain the incident to the customer and tell them the payment will be retried automatically, and when the retries complete. Retries follow the processor's usual schedule, which past payment-processor incident notices show. Don't open a Billing Ops case for it.

This replaces the failed-payment section of the 2026 "Failed Card Payments and Card Updates" page.

## Outside the window
A payment failure outside a published incident window still goes to Billing Ops (see the billing case routing and handoffs page).

_Last reviewed 2027-03-15._
